title: Integral exceptional inverse image along the projective line and affine space
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$. Work with separated finite-type $k$-schemes and their $k$-morphisms, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. For each such scheme $T$, use the bounded constructible category $\Dbc(T,\mathcal O_E)$ of [sk-def-sfb-constructible], in the unbounded derived category of modules over the pulled-back condensed coefficient sheaf $\mathcal O_{E,T}$. Put $\mathcal L(T)=\Loc(\Dbc(T,\mathcal O_E))$ as in [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Let $f^!$ be the right adjoint supplied by [det-prop-int-brown-adjoint]. Tate twists mean [sk-def-sp-tate-twist].

For a standing scheme $Y$ and $d\in\mathbb N$, let $q:\mathbf P^1_Y\to Y$ and $p_d:\mathbf A^d_Y\to Y$ be the structural projections ([def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], [def-sbc-affine-space]). Then:
1. $Rq_*\dashv q^*(1)[2]$ on $\mathcal L(\mathbf P^1_Y)$ and $\mathcal L(Y)$, and $q^!\simeq q^*(1)[2]$.
2. $p_d^!\simeq p_d^*(d)[2d]$ as functors $\mathcal L(Y)\to\mathcal L(\mathbf A^d_Y)$.
3. $q^*(1)[2]$ and $p_d^*(d)[2d]$ map $\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ into $\Dbc(\mathbf P^1_Y,\mathcal O_E)$ and $\Dbc(\mathbf A^d_Y,\mathcal O_E)$ respectively.

proof.text: Apply signed integral Tate-line constructibility to P1_Y and A^d_Y. Transport source bounded constructibility to the constant-model predicate on the standing noetherian quasi-compact schemes. Integral pullback and tensor preserve it, and shifts preserve it. This proves both bounded-constructible assertions.

The unshifted composite of derived pullback and right tensor is triangulated and a left adjoint. The preimage of the target localizing property is therefore replete, triangulated and closed under small sums. It contains the constructible generators by the preceding step (undo the even shift). Minimality of the localizing closure, followed by shift stability, proves both hq and hp.

Use integralLocalizingCompactSupport on the identity-open compactification of the proper projection q. The identity extension-by-zero isomorphism identifies its image with Rq_*, giving hr. Compactification independence identifies every boundary lowerShriek with this restrictedPush; lift that ambient isomorphism through the full inclusions.

Apply the isolated projective-line adjunction with hq and hr. Its right-adjoint uniqueness and the compactification comparison prove the projective Brown comparison. Apply affine purity induction to each boundary compactification with hp and its given preservation proof. Right-adjoint uniqueness proves the affine Brown comparison. Assemble these with the two constructibility assertions and the three preservation proofs.

proof_origin.place: Clauses (1)-(3): fully formal preservation, proper compactification transport and right-adjoint uniqueness; three geometric source arguments isolated as named lemmas.
